name: guardrails
description: Safety and review of Claude's output, styled after claude-flightdeck (rounded role-coloured boxes, ▰▱ gauges, busy rails; every button also has a hotkey; options palette theme|pastel and motion). Six mods, each toggled in the plugin config. blast-radius: holds destructive shell commands (rm -rf, git push --force, git reset --hard, DROP TABLE...) behind a three-row BLAST RADIUS card showing the files at risk; pick Proceed or Cancel. secret-sentry: denies Write/Edit/NotebookEdit that would put API keys, tokens or private keys in a file (.env and *.example exempt). reflect: spots lasting corrections in your prompts (or 'remember: ...') and offers to save them to ./CLAUDE.md or ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md; /reflect-queue, /reflect-pause. assumption-tracker: after each turn lists what Claude assumed; mark Right or Wrong (or 1-8 to cycle) and send a fix for the wrong ones (f); /assumptions. self-critique: /critique [auto|opus|sonnet|haiku] reviews Claude's last answer with a verdict, flaws and a Make this fix button (r rerun, a auto, m model, 1-n fix). prompt-coach: on the first prompt of a session only (a first /command or skill prompt included; tracked per session id so a reload cannot re-fire it) it holds the prompt and shows one improved prompt in a side pane, with instructions telling the main session to grill you about ambiguities and unclear requirements before it starts; Use in prompt box (u, to edit before sending), Copy (c), Request changes (e) or Dismiss (d, sends the original); a first /command keeps its line verbatim at the top; a first prompt with attachments is sent as typed and the improved text is only offered; never auto-triggers again after the first prompt; /sharpen [prompt] runs it any time (typed text, else the prompt box, else your last message).
